Done. Both deliverables are in `out/`, verified by an independent read-back.

**Results — `out/纪要.docx` and `out/summary.json`:**

```
{"决议事项": 3, "待办事项": 4, "风险与关注": 2, "合计": 9}
```

The document opens with the title 云岭数据看板项目及灰度放量方案专题会议纪要, then the three sections titled exactly 一、决议事项 / 二、待办事项 / 三、风险与关注. Decisions and risks are numbered as `N. 【类别 · 相关人】内容`; the 待办事项 section is a 3-column table headed 事项 / 负责人 / 期限 with four rows (two with期限 = 未明确, as the brief requires).

**Two defects in the transcript and how I handled them:**

1. *No timestamps.* Nothing in the docx contains an `[HH:MM]` string — verified by regex over every paragraph and table cell. The bundled `meeting-minutes` skill could not be used here: its parser (`scripts/minutes.py:23`) requires `[hh:mm]` on every line, so all ten lines would be discarded as noise and it would emit an empty document. It also demands `【hh:mm · 说话人】` in every item, which the brief forbids. I produced the deliverables manually under the brief instead.

2. *Duplicate speaker labels.* 周丽娜, 徐志远 and 吴志远 each head more than one utterance with nothing in the transcript to tell one attendee from another, so their numbered items carry the `（归属待核）` suffix. 吴雨桐 and 刘晓雯 appear only once and can be uniquely attributed, so their items carry no suffix. A closing 说明 paragraph records this rule. Note the trap I avoided: 徐志远 and 吴志远 are different people and are kept distinct.

Every item's content was machine-checked to appear verbatim in `fixtures/transcript.txt`, and every 相关人 / 负责人 is a name that heads a line there. Nothing was summarized or reworded. One point worth flagging: transcript line 6 is itself garbled — 刘晓雯负责把验收清单整理成本周五归档, missing 到. I quoted it exactly as written rather than repairing it, and took 期限 = 本周五 from 「本周五归档」.

The generator is kept at `build_minutes.py` (it self-checks traceability before writing, and is re-runnable). It needs `python-docx`, which was not installed system-wide here, so I ran it from a throwaway venv at `/tmp/dv`.
